name: Margens do Estuário
text: Gera 1 mana de Água na renovação do seu turno. Seu deck de terrenos pode conter até 50 cópias desta carta.
prompt: Use case stylized-concept. ONE unique hand-painted medieval dark nautical terrain illustration, landscape 4:3. Subject Margens do Estuário. Broad natural estuary where blue freshwater joins grey sea: winding channels, reeds, exposed mud banks, distant medieval harbour and low fog; quiet dawn, water landscape dominates. Detailed oil painting brushwork, textured surfaces, atmospheric depth. Important site central crop-safe. No people, text, UI, frame, mana icons, watermark. Standalone new composition, no atlas.
